body:
Refs #1448. Part of #1448.

Depends on #3324 (the shared mechanism). Do not start before #3324 is merged. The `blocked` label goes when #3324 is closed.

The Offset2D slice also depends on #3316 ("Pass starts at"). Do not start it before #3316 is merged (comment on #1448, 2026-11-22).

## What happens

A user cannot set where these operations enter the material or where they leave it. `sane.rs:71-87` refuses a start or an exit point on each of them: "a {what} point is taken only by the 2D contour so far - clear it on this operation". The maintainer reported this for `2D Offset1` on 2026-11-22: its Lead in / Lead out tab has no Start point row and no Exit point row.

## Expected

| Kind | Start | Exit | Seam (from the research pass) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocket | the descent place (helix, ramp, plunge) of the first pass, at the pick | the end of the last pass, nearest the pick | `machining2d/pocket_emit.rs:60-94`, `descent.rs:101-305`, `descent_xy.rs` |
| Offset2D | the place on the first ring that "Pass starts at" gives, and the descent there | the place on the last ring | offset arm `operation/generate.rs:854` |
| Circular | the angle of the pick on the circle | the same angle after the last turn, or the exit angle | `machining2d/circular.rs:166,223` |
| Slot, TrochoidalSlot | the end `a` or `b` nearest the pick | the other end | `machining2d/slots.rs:132`, `generate.rs:2024-2080` |
| Trace, Engrave, Chamfer2D | the end of an open chain nearest the pick, or the projection on a closed chain | the other end, or the projection | `slots.rs:327`, arms `generate.rs:2107,2145,2189` |

The contour items of #1473 (open chains, tilt, compensation) stay in #1473. Pre-drilled entry positions stay in their own issue.

## Laws a pick must keep (refused by name, never moved)

- Lead room: the lead-in and the lead-out fit the legal cutter region (`contour_start.rs:380` `lead_held`).
- Entry: the helix or the ramp fits in the region at the pick. A tool that is not centre-cutting gets `CENTER_CUT_REFUSAL`.
- Reach: the pick is near the cutter path (`contour_start.rs:110`).
- Pass side: on an Outside band, the start is on the outer boundary, outside the part (#1448 design note). A pick that the pass side makes impossible is refused.
- First traverse (`operation/first_traverse.rs:45`) and the keep-stock check (`generate.rs:3534`) still judge the result.

## Done means

- Each kind in the table takes a start point and an exit point through the shared mechanism of #3324, or its row says by name why it does not.
- For each kind: a pin test shows the entry at the pick, a pin test shows the exit at the pick, and a pin test shows an impossible pick refused by name.
- Undo and redo restore the previous path. MCP `edit_operation` sets the picks.
- Every shipped golden without a pick is byte-identical.
- Work it in slices, one kind (or one seam) for each PR, each with `Refs` to this issue.

Safety floor: this changes toolpaths and posted G-code. The review is an `effort:high` review with a hand trace.
